rationale: The agent proceeded to submit an exchange without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the explicit policy requirement to confirm before any write. Although the tool call sequence suggests the agent likely authenticated (found user by name/zip and pulled user/order/product details), it did not attempt to place a new order first as requested by the user (or explain why it could not), and instead directly executed an exchange. Additionally, the agent stated a specific refund amount and PayPal refund without visible supporting tool results in the transcript. These issues fail the pass bar despite evidence of user/order lookup.
